description: One synthetic star field (400x300, 45 stars, two of them saturated, sky 1000 ADU with a gradient, sigma 18 ADU) in every sample convention the app reads. The test imaging/tests/sample_range_conventions.rs checks that star detection, HFR, statistics, histogram, stretch, thumbnail, calibration and registration give the same answers for all of them.
made_by: make_scene.py (numpy) wrote scene_u16.fits and unmarked_f32_adu.fits. PixInsight 1.9.4 (headless, pixinsight.js) opened scene_u16.fits and saved the pi_* files: ImageWindow.setSampleFormat, then saveAs with zstd+sh for XISF.

files.unmarked_f32_adu.fits: the scene as float FITS in ADU with no range cards: what Skotiq wrote for float masters before it declared a range
files.pi_scene_u32.xisf: PixInsight UInt32 XISF (the 16-bit levels spread over the 32-bit range)
files.pi_scene_f32.fits: PixInsight Float32 FITS, samples in 0..1, no range card
files.pi_scene_rgb_f32.xisf: PixInsight Float32 RGB XISF: R = 0.8 scene, G = scene, B = 0.6 scene
files.pi_scene_rgb_u16.xisf: the same RGB image as UInt16 XISF

pixinsight_reads: Measured with pixinsight.js: an XISF Float32 file with bounds 0:65535 holding ADU reads in PixInsight exactly as the 16-bit frame (median 0.0157472); samples outside the bounds are truncated. A float FITS outside 0..1 is rescaled from its own extremes whatever cards it has.
